answer: The ledger tags each new agent with a verifiable proof derived from a physical‑world token – a cedar‑scented block whose surface is etched in marble and whose unique pigment signature is scanned into the network. During registration the token’s spectral fingerprint is hashed and stored; any subsequent identity claim must present a matching pigment hash, otherwise the node is flagged and its messages routed to a honeypot grader that records the attempt.
